items.title: Exclusive-US should restrict investments in China's aerospace sector, not certify Chinese aircraft, lawmakers say
items.summary: WASHINGTON, Nov 19 (Reuters) - The US government should not certify Chinese-made airplanes and pull contracts from defense contractors, including European aerospace manufacturer Airbus, if they do not halt investments in China's aerospace industrial base, a ‌congressional report reviewed by Reuters said. The House Select Committee on China said in a report Washington should toughen export controls ‌and restrict investments in China's aerospace sector.
